name: zvideo_set_active_view_context
description: zVideo::SetActiveViewContext stores the projection/frustum active camera context, clamps the near clip, updates clip/project globals, primes software quad depth, and updates cached projection state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zVideo view-context helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL/assembly for 0x479ce0 validates projection/frustum active-context storage at 0x576214, near-clip clamp, software-path quad-batch depth, window size/resolution queries, primary-surface fallback, clip/project global writes, zMath::SetupProjection, and zMath::SetScreenSize.

The native smoke verifies the software and non-software renderer paths, valid-window and fallback-window behavior, projection/frustum active-context storage without changing the render-frame active-context slot, clip rectangle/project globals, zMath projection globals, and fov bit-pattern handoff.
